feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Greetings from Edinburgh, where a cheeky tour guide makes art history hilarious
entry.summary: For anyone who grew up staring blankly at museum artwork, this is the fun that was missing: Coco leads interactive and (mostly) factual art history comedy tours.

entry.title: Is Nepal's flood a harbinger of what's to come in the Himalayas?
entry.summary: Building dams and hydropower plants in the Himalayas holds great promise for providing electricity. In the wake of the Nepal disaster, experts are asking about the risks of such construction.

entry.title: Dems have an edge over GOP, poll finds. And, ICE looks into 'mobile detention centers'
entry.summary: An NPR poll shows that Democrats have an edge over Republicans going into the midterms, partially due to Trump. And, Immigration and Customs Enforcement is looking into "mobile detention centers."

entry.title: U.S. ambassador to the U.N. discusses Trump's address at UNGA
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with U.S. Ambassador to the U.N. Mike Waltz about President Trump's trip to the U.N. General Assembly and whether progress has been made on key issues.

entry.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy proposes energy truce with Russia during meeting with Trump
entry.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met President Trump at the U.N. and proposed that Ukraine and Russia stop attacking each other's energy systems.

entry.title: Trump lays out his agenda as middle powers call for more cooperation at UNGA
entry.summary: Middle powers plead for more cooperation at the United Nations, as President Trump lays out his America First agenda and defends the U.S. war against Iran.

entry.title: The United Nations General Assembly is meeting. Is it accomplishing anything?
entry.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with Michael Froman, Council on Foreign Relations president, at the UN General Assembly.

entry.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 over deadly 2019 Easter bombings
entry.summary: The Islamic State group-inspired attacks were among the deadliest in Sri Lanka's history, killing 42 foreigners.

entry.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump. And, Paramount settles in massive merger lawsuit
entry.summary: CNN, MS NOW and Politico have sued Trump after the networks were suspended from the White House. And, Paramount makes concessions to resolve a lawsuit over its massive Warner Bros. Discovery merger.

entry.title: Houthis try to push deeper into western Yemen, upending life, witnesses tell NPR
entry.summary: As the U.S. conflict with Iran drags, the Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen have opened a new front, taking new territory and displacing more than 100,000 people.
